name: Cetc Potevio Science&Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Cetc Potevio Science&Technology Co.,Ltd., a company headquartered in Guangzhou, China, delivers extensive network communication solutions across the nation. Its operations include the strategic planning and design of mobile communication infrastructure, as well as providing specialized private network communication services for various industries. The firm also offers network electronic system engineering and supervision, alongside manufacturing components such as communication and specialized printed circuit boards and devices. Beyond these, Cetc Potevio supplies a broad range of communication network systems and associated services. They are also active in innovative technological fields, providing services for smart city initiatives, the Internet of Things (IoT), and cloud computing. Their product line further includes network coverage equipment like antennas, repeaters, and WLAN technology. The company was founded in 1994 and was previously known as GCI Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
